types.name: Units and instruments
types.description: SI and other units, unit conversions, and instruments and what they measure.

types.name: Motion, force, gravity and energy
types.description: Speed and acceleration, Newton's laws, momentum, gravitation, work, energy, power and simple machines.

types.name: Pressure and properties of matter
types.description: Pressure, Pascal's and Archimedes' principles, floating, Bernoulli, surface tension, capillarity, viscosity and states of matter.

types.name: Heat, sound and waves
types.description: Heat transfer, temperature scales, gas laws, sound and its properties, and the electromagnetic spectrum.

types.name: Light and optics
types.description: Reflection, refraction, mirrors, lenses, eye defects, dispersion, scattering and natural light effects.

types.name: Electricity and magnetism
types.description: Current, Ohm's law, circuits, household electricity, cells, magnetic effects of current, motors, generators and transformers.

types.name: Atoms, nuclear physics and scientists
types.description: Atomic structure and discoveries, radioactivity, fission and fusion, and physicists with their laws and inventions.
